title: Open a PCB drawing and update it from the board
summary: Opens a Draftsman drawing (.PCBDwf) by document kind, focuses it with ShowDocument and runs the Draftsman process PcbDrawing:UpdateBoard (Import Changes From Board) on it, reporting the modified flag before and after.
phrasings: import changes from board into a Draftsman drawing
open a .PCBDwf document from an extension
run another server's process with RunCommand
focus a document before running a process

commands.name: OpenDrawing
commands.description: Open a PCB drawing (.PCBDwf) and import changes from its board
commands.params: File=<path of a .PCBDwf> (required on the pipe; the menu asks with a file dialog)|Update=false (optional: open and focus only)
